lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: problem-solving routines

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: Which expression means: “Multiply 17 by 5, then subtract the product from 153.”
Which phrase describes 38 + [4 × (13 - 11)] without evaluating it?
choices: Subtract 11 from 13, multiply the difference by 4, then add 38.
Add 38 and 4, then multiply the sum by the difference of 13 and 11.
Add 13 and 11, multiply the sum by 4, then add 38.
Subtract 11 from 13, add 4, then multiply the sum by 38.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Let E represent 2788 + 6885. Without evaluating, how does (2788 + 6885) + 744 compare with E?
A supply cart has 49 boxes with 36 markers in each box and 6 loose markers. Which expression represents the total number of markers?
A team packs 59 crates with 32 bottles in each crate, adds 33 loose bottles, and then uses 75 bottles. How many bottles remain?
In 3486668, how does the value of the 6 in the thousands place compare with the value of the 6 in the hundreds place?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: Round each number to the nearest thousand to estimate 451500 - 117500.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Round 550 to the nearest hundred and 75 to the nearest ten, then multiply to estimate the product.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
